name: PegaBall
summary: buyGamesFrom self-funds purchases from the proxy balance instead of requiring msg.value, letting a vendor drain vendor/referrer cuts.
notes: Constructor-time Upgraded event selected the vulnerable PegaBallV1 implementation.
The exploit trace records 258 outward ETH transfers from the proxy: 0.290589 ETH to the attacker and 0.290589 ETH to the attack contract. Self-calls and DELEGATECALL frame values are excluded.
